notes.title: Fruitalistic V1.1.0 (Bramley)
notes.notes:
Fruitalistic! V1.1.0 (Bramley) update notes:
-New unlockable hat (Jester)
-A new area, with 9 new levels (Fig Forest, area 2). This brings the total level count to 69.

I've decoupled the Quality of Life updates to get this additional content out sooner, as that will take a little more work, hoping to include in the next or subsequent patch.

Timi @AToPlay

notes.title: Fruitalistic! Update 1.0.5 (Launcher R3) is live
notes.notes:
This is the last release candidate before launch, with a couple of updates:
-Darkened the backgrounds being rendered, to contrast the foreground better and reduce visual intensity in general
-Some modifications to the camera, to normalise some of the movement scroll speeds

The previous update, Launcher R2 also brought 9 new levels to Blueberry Beach (Area 2), bringing the level count up to 60.

Next update will likely focus on more quality of life issues, as well as potentially another level set drop!

Thanks,

Timi @AToPlay
